steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Component 3: perform two extracts from ONE play — assessed by a visiting examiner. | Key Fact: Group work: you are assessed INDIVIDUALLY even in a group performance — you must maintain character and focus throughout. | Key Fact: Preparation: full dress and technical rehearsals before the exam day — no surprises on the day. | Key Fact: Focus under pressure: if something goes wrong, STAY IN CHARACTER and adapt — the examiner assesses how you handle the moment.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What should you do if something goes wrong during a performance for the examiner? Why is this important? | Describe how you would prepare for a visiting examiner assessment from one week before to the performance day. | How are individual performers assessed within a group performance? What does the examiner look for?
